observations: I opened assets/panels/05-4.png, main-cast.png and page-05.png and looked at them myself. This is an over-the-shoulder shot. The back of Ravi's head, with short dark hair and a beard edge, and his green-shirted shoulder fill the lower-right foreground. Ananya faces him across the desk with the window and plant behind her.

Ananya matches her sheet: low bun, gold stud, heavy-lidded almond eyes, white coat, teal kurta, stethoscope not in use. Her hands are folded on the desk. Small motion marks by her head show a mid-nod. She looks at Ravi, not at the laptop, with a gentle smile.
The laptop at the left edge of the desk shows three abstract cards and a small glowing microphone with sound-wave marks. I found no text.
On page-05.png the caption sits on the plain upper wall. Her face, folded hands and the laptop's microphone are uncovered.
